items.journal: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery – Global Open
items.title: Cephalad Migration of Permanent Thread Fragments Following Nose Augmentation by Thread
items.fact_zh: 1 例 54 岁女性，鼻部线雕隆鼻 5 年后额部不平、眉间硬块；手术取出 8 段移位线（2 蓝 6 透明），nuclear magnetic resonance（核磁共振，NMR）证实为聚丙烯-聚乳酸共聚物。
items.take_zh: 创新点：把多年后的线头移位追到具体共聚物材料与皱眉肌、额肌反复收缩的力学，而非笼统异物反应。意义：问诊要追问线材成分和植入年限，眉间、额部不明硬结先想到线头上移，取出按深部异物设计。
items.scene_zh: 患者说五年前做过线雕隆鼻，现在眉间鼓了个硬包，我问她记不记得当时用的什么线，她说忘了——这种就得按永久线移位来查。
items.fact_en: A 54-year-old woman presented five years after thread-based nasal augmentation with forehead irregularity and a firm glabellar mass; exploration retrieved eight migrated thread fragments (two blue, six transparent) along the glabella and forehead. Nuclear magnetic resonance identified the material as a polypropylene–polylactic acid copolymer, and repeated procerus and frontalis contraction with unidirectional barbs was thought to drive cephalad migration.
items.take_en: The value is tracing a late thread complication to a specific copolymer and to muscle mechanics rather than a generic foreign-body reaction. Ask patients about thread composition and implant age, and treat unexplained glabellar or forehead nodules after nasal threading as possible migrated threads; retrieval needs a deep-foreign-body approach.

items.journal: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery – Global Open
items.title: Mailbox Flap Mastopexy: Structural Internal Support Technique to Enhance Lower Pole Stability Breast Ptosis Correction
items.fact_zh: 84 例假体隆胸同期乳房上提（2021–2024），平均 39.7 岁，60.7% 为二次上提；4×4 厘米皮腺瓣锚定胸大肌，90.5% 完全矫正下垂，并发症 23.8%，BREAST-Q 从 35.2 升至 93.8 分。
items.take_zh: 创新点：用一块 4×4 厘米去上皮皮腺瓣锚到胸大肌做内支撑，把下极稳定从皮肤受力改成结构受力。意义：假体隆胸合并中度下垂、尤其二次上提可少依赖皮肤张力；但并发症 23.8%、无对照，满意度和随访期要如实讲。
items.scene_zh: 患者问隆胸同时能不能把下垂一起提上去，我说可以，但会用一块自己的腺体瓣兜住下极，疤痕和愈合不良的风险要先讲清楚。
items.fact_en: In a retrospective cohort of 84 patients having mastopexy with implants between 2021 and 2024 (mean age 39.7 years, mean BMI 23.7), 60.7% were secondary lifts and most had Regnault grade 2 (65.5%) or 3 (31.0%) ptosis. A 4 × 4 cm dermoglandular flap was anchored to the pectoralis with limited subpectoral myotomy; complete ptosis correction was achieved in 90.5%, complications occurred in 23.8% (mainly minor wound dehiscence 5.9%, hypertrophic scar 3.6%, asymmetry 3.6%), and BREAST-Q scores rose from 35.2 to 93.8 (P < 0.001).
items.take_en: The innovation is a dermoglandular flap fixed to the pectoralis to support the lower pole structurally instead of relying on skin. It is a reasonable option for moderate ptosis with implants, especially secondary lifts, but the 23.8% complication rate and lack of a control group mean the satisfaction gain and follow-up must be presented honestly.
